components.name: CRI-Net (ANGEL SWARM compensatory reserve estimator)
components.description: One-dimensional CNN estimating compensatory reserve from a 5-second, 100 Hz photoplethysmogram window. 104,162 parameters, ONNX opset 13. Trained in this repository on a synthetic cohort; no patient data was used at any point.

properties.name: angel:provenance
properties.value: Synthetic cohort. Waveform morphology follows the published response of the peripheral pulse to central volume loss; it is not patient data and no patient data was used. The fielded analogue is CipherOx CRM, FDA 510(k) K173929.

properties.name: angel:heldOutSplit
properties.value: by subject — no person appears in both sets

modelParameters.task: regression — compensatory reserve index in [0,1], with a log predictive variance head
modelParameters.modelArchitecture: 1-D CNN, input 1x1x500 (5 s at 100 Hz), per-window zero-mean unit-variance normalisation

useCases: Sort key inside a materiel tasking optimiser. It is not a diagnosis and is not surfaced to a clinician as a finding.
technicalLimitations: Trained and evaluated entirely on a synthetic cohort. It has never seen a real photoplethysmogram.
Peripheral vasoconstriction in haemorrhagic shock degrades the very signal the estimate depends on, so quality falls as the casualty deteriorates.
No clinical validation has been performed. The fielded analogue is the FDA-cleared CipherOx CRM (510(k) K173929); this network is not that device and is not cleared.

components.name: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (int8)
components.description: Sentence-embedding encoder, 384 dimensions, ONNX opset 14, dynamically quantised to int8 in this repository. Used only to retrieve doctrine passages for the Ask ANGEL screen.

supplier.name: sentence-transformers / Hugging Face community model, obtained through npm

properties.name: angel:acquisitionRoute
properties.value: npm @lat.md/embed-minilm-fp16 (fp16 safetensors + tokenizer); huggingface.co is unreachable from the build sandbox

properties.name: angel:licenceEvidence
properties.value: app/models/minilm/meta.json declares Apache-2.0 for all-MiniLM-L6-v2; the upstream sentence-transformers model card carries the same identifier. No LICENSE file ships beside the weights in this repository.

properties.name: angel:quantisationFidelity
properties.value: fp32 vs int8 minimum cosine similarity 0.9686230421066284

modelParameters.modelArchitecture: MiniLM, 6 layers, 384-dimensional output, int8 dynamic quantisation

technicalLimitations: Retrieves over a 161-passage paraphrased demonstration corpus, not over an authoritative publication.
Measured 15 of 23 evaluation questions correct at rank 1 and 22 of 23 within the top 5.
